## 🛡️ Scams & safety alerts

- **North Korean fake job interview crypto heist:**
  - *How the scam works:* Cybercriminals pose as corporate recruiters on professional network platforms, convincing software developers to download tampered tools or run malicious terminal scripts during remote technical interviews.
  - *What to do:* Never download unverified executable files or run terminal code provided by unfamiliar recruiters during job interviews. [[The Hacker News]](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/binance-reveals-how-fake-job-interviews.html) [[BleepingComputer]](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/binance-says-fake-job-interview-led-to-63-billion-crypto-heist/)

- **Digital arrest and fake stock trading app frauds:**
  - *How the scam works:* Scammers impersonate police or SEBI officials via video calls, threatening immediate arrest or tricking victims into investing through fake trading applications.
  - *What to do:* Law enforcement and financial regulators never conduct arrests via video calls or demand money transfers; report suspicious calls to 1930 immediately. [[The Indian Express]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOQTNNSG5DRzVPUzItaUdqQVVveXMtZVZCaDUzTU9RT25BQ2czR2J4RWtqVlRFME9oN1hyNlFLZVRsX3Z4OEs0aXI0ZkZSZFlCX2gta2dBTUlTVllVRlpJMmVSeHh4amZ2ZGF4aGxlbzYzZm5GSFh2aUZnMFJTdzgzY2ZPQkZXVjFGTm9peDFhOUFtcWQ5MG9lWlROUTBfZURqMjNQaXpQQ0VxQjZUcXdYYkVMeTZ3S3FIRWJj?oc=5) [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Hyderabad Mail]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQazB4aURLcHZuN09PcFJZWFJVVmJwNl9MT2lseWJCdHFvUHM1ckxicGJKTlZsZFRDclRLNjFtTWU1R2dpTjRsRXFTdVFtbDhObVNGbFgwUWVKSXhxUlFRZERuaG03T2xUaEtpamRRdTNjNDVKUGtaNjRuUVFPRmc1RDlKVHhjN3dRWGtURFQ4cHJ2Zzg?oc=5)

## 🎓 Today's lesson

- **Viability Gap Funding (VGF):** Viability Gap Funding is a one-time government financial grant provided to support infrastructure projects that are economically essential but financially unviable for private investors on their own. For example, large grid-scale battery storage requires heavy upfront capital. By offering ₹14,500 crore in VGF, the Indian government covers part of the initial project cost, lowering investment risk and helping private firms build storage plants that keep ultimate electricity prices affordable. [[PIB (official)]](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2332553)
